meta.title: GarudaKids FC — Akademi Sepak Bola Usia Muda Sidoarjo

description.id: Akademi sepak bola usia muda di Sidoarjo, Jawa Timur. GarudaKids FC membina pemain muda melalui pelatihan profesional, program terstruktur, disiplin, kerja sama tim, dan pengalaman kompetitif.
description.en: A youth football academy in Sidoarjo, East Java. GarudaKids FC develops young players through professional coaching, structured training, teamwork, discipline, and competitive experience.

text.en: Play for the team, support each other, understand every role.
